usageNotes: Retrieves the list of local user accounts from inside a running QEMU VM via the QEMU Guest Agent (QGA). The VM must be running and the guest agent must be installed and active; otherwise the call will fail with a timeout or agent error. Caller requires either VM.GuestAgent.Audit or VM.GuestAgent.Unrestricted on /vms/{vmid}.

examples.summary: List local users on VM 101 hosted on node pve1

tips: The guest agent daemon (qemu-guest-agent) must be running inside the VM; check its status with get_nodes_node_qemu_vmid_agent_info before calling.
The response wraps the raw QGA payload in a 'result' key; parse result.return to access the array of user objects (name, domain, full-name where available).
On Windows guests, domain-joined accounts appear with a domain prefix; on Linux, domain is typically empty.
If the agent is unresponsive, consider calling get_nodes_node_qemu_vmid_status_current first to confirm the VM is running.
